name: 86 Chaos 16.0.15 Schedule Hours Math Fix
label: 16.0.15 Schedule Hours Math Fix
notes: Fixes Scheduled Hours Tracker math for legacy AM/PM shift strings such as 10a-9p and 10p-3p.
Deduplicates exact duplicate shift documents per employee/day/time so hidden duplicate writes do not inflate weekly totals.
Keeps Schedule Builder visible shift chips and labor projections aligned with the hours tracker.
